verdict.rationale: Docs define a skill as a plain directory with a `SKILL.md` file (name and description frontmatter) plus optional scripts and references, discovered from `.agents/skills` folders that teams can check into repos. That makes skills readable and copyable, not a binary format. Portability is supported by the 'portable Agent Plugins package' schema, a Claude Code plugin migration path, and a community note that Claude Skills came to Codex. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SKILL.md folders run unchanged in another harness, and hands-on corroboration of actually moving a skill between agents.
